data.text:
Vijendra Kumar Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy.
... on 21 August, 2024 
Author: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
Bench: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:56892
Court No. - 4
Case :- Writ - A No. - 6617 of 2024
Petitioner :- Vijendra Kumar Mishra
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Khadya Suraksha And Aushadhi Prashas
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vijay Pathak,Rakesh Pathak 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
1.  Heard Sri Rakesh Pathak, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Jogendra Nath Verma,
learned Standing Counsel.
2. By means of the present petition, the petitioner has assailed the office order dated 30.06.2024 passed by the opposite party No.2/ Additional Commisoner (Administration) Food Safety And Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow transferring the petitioner from Ayodhya to Raebareli in public interest. 
Vijendra Kumar Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 21 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93001428/
1 3. Learned Counsel for the petitioner has stated that the petitioner was promoted from the post of Senior Assistant to the post of Head Assistant on 25.07.2023 but on account of compelling family circumstances as his father is 80 years old and there is no one in the family to look after him, he had foregone his promotion making request that he may be permitted to serve on the post of Senior Assistant at his present place of posting i.e. Ayodhya. Annexure No. 2 is a letter dated 03.08.2023 preferred by Assistant Commissioner, Food Safety And Drug Administration, Ayodhya to the Commissioner, Food Safety And Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow apprising that the petitioner had foregone his promotion and requested to be posted at Ayodhya to look after his old aged father. 
Pursuant to the aforesaid development, the petitioner was not promoted on the post of Head Assistant and he was discharging his duties on the post of Senior Assistant at Ayodhya. Learned Counsel for the petitioner has further submitted that the petitioner has not been relieved from Ayodhya and presently he is on medical leave. 
4. Learned Counsel has drawn attention of this court towards Annexure No. 3 which is a transfer order of one Shri Pradeep Kumar Maurya who is transferred form Maharajganj to Ayodhya in place of the petitioner in public interest but the aforesaid employee namely Pradeep Kumar Maurya could not submit his joining at Ayodhya for the reason that he is suffering from Oral Cancer since 2015 and he had undergone five operations of the said ailment. In his representation dated 01.07.2024 (No.4), Pradeep Kumar Maurya has apprised the aforesaid fact to the Commissioner, Food Safety And Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow. He has also stated that he cannot eat any solid food and he is taking only liquid food and he is not able to travel long distance and his family, including his old aged parents, are settled at Maharajganj, therefore, his transfer order may be stayed. Learned counsel has stated that on account of aforesaid reasons, Pradeep Kumar Maurya has not submitted his joining at Ayodhya, however, he is not aware as to whether the transfer of Pradeep Kumar Maurya has been cancelled or not. 
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner has further submitted that immediately after the transfer order being passed on 30.06.2024, he preferred a representation dated 04.07.2024 (No.5) wherein he has categorically indicated that so as to meet out his extreme family conditions to take care of his old aged father, he had foregone his promotion, therefore, he may be permitted to be retained at Ayodhya.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner has further submitted that no decision has been taken by the Commissioner, Food Safety And Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow till date. 
7. Sri Jogendra Nath Verma, learned Standing Counsel has stated that he has no instruction as to whether any decision has been taken by the competent authority or not and also as to whether the petitioner has been relieved from Ayodhya to the transferred place i.e. Raebareli or not. 
8. Be that as it may, if the petitioner had foregone his promotion on the post of Head Assistant to meet out his extreme family circumstances to look after his old aged father who is permanently residing at Ayodhya, unless there is any extreme administrative reason or any extreme administrative exigency to transfer the petitioner from Ayodhya, his bonafide grievance should have been considered by the competent authority i.e. Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Vijendra Kumar Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 21 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93001428/
2 Administration, U.P., Lucknow.
9. Since the person who has been transferred in place of the petitioner could not submit his joining at Ayodhya for his compelling medical reasons, therefore, no third party interest has been created by now. Further, the grievance of the petitioner appears to be bonafide, therefore, it should have been considered sympathetically. 
10. Therefore, without entering into the merits of the issue, liberty is given to the petitioner to prefer a fresh representation to opposite party No.2/ Commissioner, Food Safety And Drug Administration, U.P., Lucknow, taking all pleas and grounds, which are available to him, enclosing therewith all necessary documents which are necessary for the disposal of the representation and also enclosing the earlier representation, if any, along with certified copy of this order within a period of ten days from today and if such representation is preferred by the petitioner within the aforesaid stipulated time, the authority concerned shall consider and dispose of the aforesaid representation of the petitioner sympathetically by a speaking and reasoned order, as per transfer policy, with expedition, say, within period of six weeks from the date of receipt of that representation and thereafter communicate the decision thereof to the petitioner forthwith.
11. Till the disposal of the aforesaid application or a period of two months, whichever is earlier, the petitioner shall not be relieved from his present place of posting i.e. Ayodhya, if he has not been relieved as on today, and he shall be permitted to discharge his duties as Senior Assistant at Ayodhya and shall be paid his regular salary.
12. With the aforesaid directions, the writ petition is disposed of finally. 
[Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.] Order Date :- 21.8.2024 (Manoj K.)
